Name: Council of Nicaea
Summary: The first empire-wide council of bishops, convened at Nicaea to answer Arianism's claim that Christ was created. It affirmed the Son is 'of one substance' with the Father and produced the Nicene Creed.
Contribution: Defined orthodox Christology and gave the church its most-used creed.
Testimony: The bishops' testimony under imperial pressure: truth about Christ was worth exile and division.
